A1-A2.headline: Step Up To The Plate And Play Baseball

pages.text:
Watch closely as the thrower steps up to send a fast ball across the field. Baseball is a smart team game with nine players on each side.

Teams take turns hitting and catching as they run around four bases to score.
pages.caption: Baseball

evidence.fileTitle: File:Tommy Milone gives up a home run to Mike Trout on May 21, 2017.jpg
evidence.articleCaption: Baseball

pages.text:
Baseball grew out of old 1700s ball games from England and became a huge part of life in North America. By the 1800s, fans called it America's Pastime.

The game gave people comfort and joy even during hard years.
pages.caption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

evidence.articleCaption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

pages.text:
A full game has nine parts called innings, each split into two halves. The field team spreads out across the green grass.

The thrower stands on the center hill, while the catcher waits behind the home base.
pages.caption: A pitcher handing off the ball after being taken out of the game during a mound meeting.

imageProvenance.credit: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA
imageProvenance.imageAttribution: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA (CC BY-SA 2.0)

evidence.articleCaption: A pitcher handing off the ball after being taken out of the game during a mound meeting.

pages.text:
The main contest sits between the thrower and the hitter. A judge checks each ball against a set target zone based on the hitter's height.

Three missed swings mean an out, while four wide throws let the hitter walk.
pages.caption: The strike zone determines the result of most pitches, and varies in vertical length for each batter.

imageProvenance.credit: User Mori Chan on Flickr (Original version) User Num(Crop and Remix)
imageProvenance.imageAttribution: User Mori Chan on Flickr (Original version) User Num(Crop and Remix) (CC BY 2.0)

evidence.articleCaption: The strike zone determines the result of most pitches, and varies in vertical length for each batter.

pages.text:
Top pro baseball shines in Major League Baseball, where clubs fight each year for the World Series cup.

Outside the United States, big global events like the World Baseball Classic bring top teams together from many lands.

B1-B2.headline: The Timeless Strategy Behind America's Favorite Pastime

pages.text:
Tension rises whenever a pitcher winds up to throw a fastball. Baseball is a smart team sport where nine players on each side match skill and timing.

Teams swap between batting and fielding as they try to score runs.
pages.caption: Baseball

evidence.fileTitle: File:Tommy Milone gives up a home run to Mike Trout on May 21, 2017.jpg
evidence.articleCaption: Baseball

pages.text:
Growing out of eighteenth-century English bat-and-ball games, baseball became a major cultural symbol in North America. By the 1800s, fans knew it as America's Pastime.

It offered a steady shared joy during difficult times.
pages.caption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

evidence.articleCaption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

pages.text:
A standard game lasts nine innings, each divided into a top and bottom half. Fielders spread across the diamond to guard open ground.

The pitcher throws from the central mound while the catcher works behind home plate.
pages.caption: A pitcher handing off the ball after being taken out of the game during a mound meeting.

imageProvenance.credit: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA
imageProvenance.imageAttribution: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA (CC BY-SA 2.0)

evidence.articleCaption: A pitcher handing off the ball after being taken out of the game during a mound meeting.

pages.text:
At the heart of baseball lies the duel between pitcher and batter. An umpire decides whether each pitch crosses the strike zone.

Three strikes put the batter out, while four balls send the hitter safely to first base.
pages.caption: The strike zone determines the result of most pitches, and varies in vertical length for each batter.

pages.text:
Pro baseball reaches its peak in Major League Baseball, where clubs battle for the famous World Series title.

Beyond the United States, tournaments like the World Baseball Classic showcase top national squads from around the globe.

C1-C2.headline: The Analytical Complexity Of Global Baseball Dynamics

pages.text:
Anticipation rises as the pitcher coils to deliver a high-velocity fastball. Baseball pits two nine-player squads in calculated spatial strategy.

Alternating offense and defense, teams advance runners across four bases.
pages.caption: Baseball

evidence.articleCaption: Baseball

pages.text: Evolving from eighteenth-century English bat-and-ball traditions, baseball matured into an enduring North American cultural institution. Dubbed America's Pastime by the nineteenth century, it offered communal continuity during national upheaval.
pages.caption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

evidence.articleCaption: Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox. The Green Monster is visible beyond the playing field.

pages.text:
Regulation contests span nine innings partitioned into alternating halves across a diamond-shaped infield and expansive outfield.

Defensive alignment anchors on the pitcher's central mound and the catcher stationed behind home plate.
pages.caption: A pitcher handing off the ball after being taken out of the game during a mound meeting.

imageProvenance.imageAttribution: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA (CC BY-SA 2.0)

pages.text:
The sport's strategic fulcrum remains the psychological duel between pitcher and batter, adjudicated by an umpire monitoring the height-calibrated strike zone.

Three strikes retire the hitter, whereas four errant pitches award first base.
pages.caption: The strike zone determines the result of most pitches, and varies in vertical length for each batter.

Professional competition culminates in Major League Baseball's annual World Series.

Internationally, tournaments such as the World Baseball Classic unite elite national rosters, highlighting baseball's global reach.
